title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
South-west Finnish Archipelago, the study site in the article ‘Marine heatwaves amplify benthic community metabolism and solute flux in a seafloor heating experiment’ (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70028).

This article is part of the cross-journal ‘Marine Heatwaves’ Special Feature, which features in this issue. The Special Feature aims to provide an interdisciplinary and cross-taxonomic view of one of the most pressing topics in marine animal science, rendering a general overview of the vulnerability of animal life to current and future marine heatwave conditions.
